caption: A side view of the Bloch sphere: |0⟩ at the top, |1⟩ at the bottom, |+⟩ and |−⟩ on the equator. The worked example (√3/2, 0, 1/2) is the point at θ = π/3 measured from |0⟩ with φ = 0, and its height z = 1/2 gives a 3/4 chance of reading 0.

spec.aria: A Bloch sphere drawn as a circle seen from the side, with |0⟩ at the north pole, |1⟩ at the south pole, |+⟩ and |−⟩ on the equator, and an arrow from the centre to the state |ψ⟩ at θ = π/3 above the equator.
